title: Pasted file/folder on Desktop should appear at cursor position if possible, just like with drag-and-drop
line: Files pasted on the desktop now appear under the pointer (or where the context menu was opened) instead of in the top-left corner.
explanation: FolderModel::paste() started a plain KIO paste job and never told the desktop where the new items should go, so the positioner put them in the first free cell at the top left. Drops already record a position per created file name and move the item there when it appears in the model. The change moves that drop logic into a small helper and has paste() use it too: a Ctrl+V paste is placed under the pointer, a paste from the context menu where the menu was opened (like Create New), and only when the point is on this desktop's screen.

commits.message:
Folder View: Place pasted items at the pointer

Pasted files always went to the first free spot on the desktop, while
dropped files land where they are dropped. Now Ctrl+V puts them under
the pointer, and Paste from the context menu where the menu was opened.

BUG: 470922

media.caption: Before: Ctrl+V with the pointer at the red mark puts the file in the top-left corner
After: the same Ctrl+V puts the file under the pointer
Before: right-click at the red mark, Paste: the file still goes to the top-left corner
After: Paste from the context menu puts the file where the menu was opened
